title: The merge tool's review_state counts a guard or check change as done only after round 3 and its net-value test
why: Coordinator 13:15 CST Nov 8: review_state counts a guard change as done when its round 2 passes. #2209 (lane review-record-before-any-push) stopped there, but owner items 359 b and 402 a need rounds 1-3 with the net-value test for any guard or check change. No step owned review_state's round count (triage grep: process-held-end-to-end, record-replacement-pr-rounds and review-rounds-rework touch review_state for other reasons). Related: merge-guard-flag-from-paths, which sets the `Guard or check` field this count depends on.
note: Sighting (lane other-checkout-cp-own, session_013NEJL3R2CBFavz7grtbJY8, 13:31 CST Nov 8): the lane handed #2125 and #2213 to runner 8 after a round-2 PASS on a guard change; runner 8 caught it and round 3 runs on both. Proposed check, folded here instead of a new step guard-record-needs-round-3: `merge --review-record` with `--guard yes` refuses a record with no round 3 and a net value of `not owed`; the remedy cites owner item 402 a. Sighting (coordinator 13:30 CST Nov 8): lane open-asks-listed-at-wake (session_013NEJL4DA5XcyP7kY5qkXP5, Sonnet) called round 3 "not owed" on a check change. Coordinator 14:30 CST Nov 8: #2252 with runner 8 at head 0d791c45e, Merge after #1353. Sighting (coordinator 14:58 CST Nov 8): #2280 re-handed with rounds 1-3 at its live head; its proposed guard (refuse a Guard-yes record with no round 3) is this step's #2252. Coordinator 15:39 CST Nov 8: routed to lane session_013NEJL33qiuVEZBa4bipxtY. Sighting (lane guard-fix-check-sonnet, #1572 round 1): merge.py's done path reads a guard-yes record as done after a FAIL, a fix check PASS and "not owed". Coordinator 15:42 CST Nov 8: the 15:39 lane (session_013NEJL33qiuVEZBa4bipxtY) was a duplicate and is dropped. #2252 (Merge after #1353, lane session_013NEJKzfKKumSC9zYS7gonr from its footer) carries the step; the write-side refusal half is dropped, because review_state is the one home. Note: rule roles-review-cap-three does not say a guard change cannot finish on a round 1 or 2 PASS; an edit there needs the owner's words. Sighting (lane reviewed-head-push-ask via the coordinator, 18:46 CST Nov 8): main's decision pr-review-record (item 402 a) says a fix-check PASS before round 3 does not end a guard review, but merge.py review_state still counts a fix PASS at any round. Same class as this step; #2252's lane checks that its change covers the fix-check path too. Not a defect (coordinator, 00:04 CST Nov 9): on #2083 a round-3 FAIL with zero or positive net value reads done by design (decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3). Second sighting (lane record-granted-round, session_013NEJL448rTgL9ZZJPUnxU1, via the coordinator 03:44 CST Nov 9; proposed as step review-state-applies-402a, folded here): on main 81a720c42 review_state computes `passed = top and (fix or top_pass)` whatever `Guard or check:` says, so a guard-yes record with a round-1 FAIL and a fix-check PASS reads done, against item 402 a (decision pr-review-record). #2252 (open) changes the rounds below the final round; confirm it covers this before a new lane starts. Confirmed (lane 03:46 CST, coordinator 03:45 CST Nov 9): #2252 at head 0d791c45e reads that case open, and tests pin it. The lane is merging main for batch 69. Sighting (coordinator 12:21 CST Nov 9, asked as step reviewed-done-guard-round3, folded here): the coordinator released #2412 to batch 69 on `merge --reviewed` reading done, though its record says guard=yes with no Round 3 line (owner item 402 a); runner 8 caught it at build, and lane session_013NEJL3115C7kVTQidSxvGj now runs that round 3. #2412's record shape is a red case for #2252, which is not yet on main. Lane review-record-provenance (#2440, 13:10 CST Nov 9): Item 402 a drift: docs/decisions/pr-review-record.md lines 36 and 61 say that a fix check PASS before round 3 does not end a change to a guard or check. merge/merge.py review_state (`passed = top and (fix or top_pass)`, about line 3302 on origin/main) and its docstring still end it. Source: the #2112 fix-check reviewer. Commits efbedb863 and 1ab44bb08 changed only the docs. Sighting (coordinator 20:13 CST Nov 9): `merge --reviewed` printed "#2481 ... done: round 1 passed" for a PR whose record says "Guard or check: yes" (it touches settings.json). The coordinator released #2481 on that "done"; runner 8 caught it, and #2481 went back to its lane for rounds 2 and 3. Fix: `merge --reviewed` reads "not done" for a guard-or-check PR with no round 3 net-value line. #2252 (this step's PR) is not on main yet. Owner asked in chat 21:43 CST Nov 9: "if something passed in round 1 why does it have mandatory follow up rounds". Page item 471 (filed 21:45 CST) asks: a, narrow #2252 to the Nov 8 ruling (round 3 only after a fix check), recommended; b, merge #2252 as built. Lanes #2488, #2489 and #2493 hold round 3 meanwhile. Owner picked 471 a on the page, 23:39 CST Nov 9: narrow #2252 to the Nov 8 ruling, so only a guard change fixed under a fix check waits for round 3. His note: "things like the net value test were only supposed to be ambiguous scenarios where u cant finish/solve by the end of the rounds". Routed to the coordinator 23:40 CST.
